header.name: Villages
header.description: Nineteen peoples with villages of their own that generate in the world: stonefolk in the hills, reedfolk on stilts in the marsh, tinkers on the savanna, tallfolk on the plains, hobbits, elves and drow in their woods, drovers in the desert, and ten furfolk - foxes, cats, wolves, rabbits, bears, fennecs, mice, squirrels, otters and deer - each in its own biome. Every person is anchored to a job post in their village, and every worker takes a trade from what stands round its post. The blueprint table: a builder raises a building block by block from the chest beside it, and takes it down again.

modules.description: Villages: peoples, job posts, structures and worldgen

settings.text: A worker takes a trade from the blocks round its post: among trees it is a lumberjack, beside farmland a farmer, at a vein a miner, by open water a fisher, in a pen of sheep a rancher; among berry bushes a forager, at an oven a baker, by a beehive a beekeeper, in a cactus garden a cactus cutter, on a mushroom bed a mushroom picker, under cocoa pods a cocoa picker, at an oak hedge a gleaner. Each cycle it walks to its work, does it, and puts what it made in the nearest chest.

Wages: a cycle costs the worker one food item from its chest. An unpaid lumberjack, miner, rancher, cactus cutter or cocoa picker waits; the trades that make food (farmer, fisher, forager, baker, beekeeper, gleaner) and the mushroom picker work regardless, since they are what fill the chest.
Workers are paid from their chest
settings.name: villages:wages

settings.text: The blueprint table: hold a blueprint and tap the table, and it shows the building, its size and the materials it needs, and places it from where you stand, toward the east and south, facing the way you face. The chest beside the table pays for it. The nearest builder walks to each spot and puts one block down at a time, from the ground up; taking a building down puts every block back in the chest.
Seconds between one block and the next
settings.name: villages:seconds_per_block

settings.text: Buildings are free: nothing is taken from the chest, and a building raised free returns nothing when it is taken down
